question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Killing of one’s own father
solution:
The correct answer is: **Patricide.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Patricide"** means the act of killing one's own father. (पितृहन्ता)

 
 
• **Example: **The character in the novel was tormented by guilt after committing patricide.
 
 
 
• **"Matricide" **refers to the act of killing one's own mother. (मातृहन्ता)
 
 
• **Example: **The tragic tale of matricide left the entire village in shock.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for the act of killing one's own father is **'Patricide'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Matricide **(मातृहन्ता): The act of killing one's own mother.

 
 
• **Example:** The legend told of a prince who committed matricide to seize the throne.
 
 
 
• **Filicide **(पुत्र/पुत्री हन्ता): The act of killing one's own son or daughter.
 
 
• **Example: **The detective was investigating a case of filicide in the small town.
 
 
 
• **Suicide** (आत्महत्या): The act of taking one's own life.
 
 
• **Example:** The community was deeply saddened by the news of his suicide.
